about: Placeholder radio lines (design sections 1 and 7: Earth speaks like scripture and holds 'biologics' in contempt; our crews are dry, deadpan, gallows humour, never zany, no jokes about the universe). Each key is a situation; lines are used in turn. {0} is a callsign. The HUD's line font has letters, digits and . , : - + / ( ) ' % only (no question or exclamation marks). Lines will be voiced later (design section 9).

ack_disable: Disabling. It can sit there and think about it.
ack_cover: Covering you. Try not to make it interesting.
I've got your back. For now.
ack_form: Coming back in. Nice and boring.
disabled: Engines gone. It's not going anywhere.
peel: I'm cut up. Pulling out to mend.
Taking too much. Backing off till it knits.
Hull's open. Give me a minute.
rejoin: Knitted. Where do you want me.
bombers: Bombers inbound on the Mercy. Somebody deal with them.
Torpedo boats on approach. We'd appreciate the company.
capital_hurt: Mercy here. Hull's going. Any time now.
beams_threat: Mercy here. The Warden's charging beams at us. Its two beam turrets, forward, on top. Take them out.
That's a beam. Somebody shut those turrets up before it cuts us in half.
beams_down: Warden's beams are quiet. Ours are free. Thank you.
That's their big guns gone. Returning the favour.
earth_wave: The fallen return to be unmade.
Kneel, remnant. Or burn where you are.
Your blood remembers Earth. Earth does not remember you.
earth_bombers: Your ark is a coffin. We will close it.
